points.description: Correct symbolic linearisation with states x=[δθ, δθdot]: A = [[0,1],[−mgℓcosθe/J, −b/J]], B = [[0],[1/J]]. Must have the cosθe term (not sinθe) in A21 with a negative sign, −b/J in A22, and 1/J in B. Using sinθe, a sign error on A21, or wrong structure loses this mark.

Correct numerical entries: A = [[0,1],[−61.3,−2.5]] (−61.3 from 1×9.81×0.25×0.5/0.02, accept 9.81 or 9.8 giving about −61.3 or −61.25), and B = [[0],[50]]. A numerical mark may be given if numbers are consistent with the student's own (even wrong) expression, but note the maximum total is 1 in such cases. B=[0,1]^T (forgetting 1/J) loses this mark.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2): correct symbolic A,B with cosθe and correct signs, and correct numbers −61.3, −2.5, 50. Common errors: sinθe giving −106.2, sign error on A21, or B=[0,1]^T each cap the total at 1. Measuring θe from the horizontal (cos30°) loses the symbolic mark. Marks are whole numbers only.
